task.topic: Among children vaccinated in the pneumococcal-conjugate-vaccine era, is asthma associated with invasive pneumococcal disease?

pico.comparator: Children without asthma or without known risk factors
outcomes: Invasive pneumococcal disease confirmed from a normally sterile site

outcome.description: Invasive pneumococcal disease confirmed from a normally sterile site

targets.effect_selection_rule: Retain each source-reported adjusted effect for the target outcome and its explicitly defined age stratum or year. Mark overlapping-cohort effects as quantitative but not independently poolable.
extraction_notes: Do not create arm counts from reported rates or ratios.
A record lacking an asthma-versus-control ratio is retained only as source-only evidence.
